howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 AM PDT 26 August 2026 Today Tonight and Thursday. Wind southerly inflow 10 knots increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon then becoming southerly inflow 10 early this evening. Wind becoming light near midnight then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 Thursday morning. Wind becoming northerly outflow 5 to 15 Thursday evening. Showers overnight and Thursday. Fog patches forming Thursday evening.
